header.data_release: expansion-v0.4 working-tree artifacts (data/embeddings, 2,619,279 rows, config generated_at 2026-05-16T12:03:15)
header.data_release_note: The v1.0-data GitHub release cache (~/.cache/bowen-data/v1.0-data, 1,361,971 rows) was still downloading when this set was built, so the fixture was cut from the local expansion artifacts instead. Section numbering is identical; row counts are not.
header.fixture: backend/tests/fixtures/mini (10 acts, deduplicated on (act_title, section_number, text))
header.retrieval_path: detect_act_from_query(q) -> search_similar(q, top_k=6, act_filter=detected_act) — the same path /chat takes
header.match_rule: expected (act, section) must appear among the top_k unique results

latency_budget_ms.note: Local budget over the 10-act mini fixture on an M-series laptop. Steady-state cost measured 2026-09-02 is ~28 ms mean / ~57 ms p95 per query (encode ~14 ms, search_similar ~16-20 ms, detect_act_from_query ~0.3 ms). Widened from 900/2000 in C-002 because the machine now co-hosts the swarm backend: one golden run taken while that process was loading its index measured p95 1075 ms / max 1782 ms with no code change. The budget is deliberately ~25x the real cost so it catches algorithmic regressions, not scheduler contention. Production over the full release measures ~3-4 s and is not covered by this budget.
